summary: Iter 16 verifies the new 'meeting_chat' side-channel + mic settings menu + realtime negotiate ?sensitivity. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass (TestSettings, TestMeetingChat, TestRealtime). Frontend: desktop RealtimeMeeting opens with meeting-chat-panel visible by default, existing meeting_chat messages render with a <table> element inside mc-msg-assistant bubbles (markdown pipe tables), send button disabled when empty, Enter sends → optimistic mc-msg-user, mc-live streaming bubble, then persisted mc-msg-assistant (count +1). Close hides the panel, localStorage key aivora_meeting_chat_open flips to '0', toggle re-opens. Mic settings popover shows mic-sens-low/medium/high + mic-noise-toggle + mic-meter; clicking mic-sens-high fires PUT /api/auth/settings and GET /api/auth/me reflects settings.mic_sensitivity='high'; toggle mic-noise-toggle persists noise_suppression. Private RealtimeCall (/chat/<private>) shows the same mic-settings-btn, meeting-chat-toggle and panel; rt-end closes. Mobile 390x844: panel hidden by default (toggle visible), toggle opens as bottom sheet, close hides. Regression: /chat regular chat-send-btn still works and 'Akhiri & Simpan Notulen' (rtm-end-save) closes meeting without JS errors.
critical_code_review_comments: chat.py MsgIn.channel uses pattern='^(meeting_chat)$' giving automatic 422 on unknown values — good. _persona_reply(via=x.channel) attaches via on BOTH user and assistant persisted docs; moderator branch is skipped when channel is set (`not x.channel`). Clean implementation.
chat.py: @mention routing still runs first via _mentioned() even for meeting_chat; only when no mention is found does it fall back to personas[:1]. Matches spec exactly.
realtime_voice.vad_config reads request.query_params['sensitivity'] with fallback to user settings; eagerness map covers all three values; interrupt_response=False as required.

auth.SettingsIn uses Pydantic pattern on mic_sensitivity + Optional[bool] for noise_suppression; update_settings merges only non-None fields so partial updates preserve previous mic_sensitivity (verified).
MeetingChatPanel: isChat filter correctly excludes voice transcripts (via='realtime' or no 'via') from the panel list; markdown table rendered with MD_DARK scoping so no leakage to the main chat.

Minor: Chat.jsx line 248 renders 'call-mode-btn' for private + 'video-call-btn' for group/meeting — testids differ from the task text which mentions video-call-btn generically; current code is correct and the integration still works end to end.
Minor: RealtimeMeeting cleanup effect on unmount calls hangup/endSessions which also fires once in StrictMode double-mount in dev — not an issue in prod, no stale OpenAI calls observed in logs.
Minor nit: streamChatWithAtt passes {channel:'meeting_chat'} alongside legacy flags; backend ignores unknown fields but keeping channel as the single source of truth is cleaner.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (desktop meeting + private realtime call + mic settings + mobile + regression)
